# S62A - Folders and documents
Reads the Horizon document extracts from PIPELINE/INPUT/DOCUMENT, rebuilds each case's folder tree from the document paths,
and outputs load-ready Folder.csv and Document.csv (exact Prisma columns) to PIPELINE/OUTPUT/DOCUMENTS/latest.
Case GUIDs use the same rule as nb_s62a_transform, so s62aCaseId joins straight onto S62aCase.id.

# Parameters
STORAGE_ACCOUNT = None                 # optional override; leave None to auto-detect from workspace
INPUT_SUBDIR    = "INPUT/DOCUMENT"     # document extract CSV(s): s62a_1/2/3_Extract_*.csv
OUTPUT_SUBDIR   = "OUTPUT/DOCUMENTS"
STORAGE_KEY     = None                 # None = Synapse identity. Fallback: ("ls_kv", "S62A-Storage-<Env>")
REF_DIGITS      = 7                    # MPA refs: S62A/YYYY/XXXXXXX

KEEP_ALL_VERSIONS   = True             # False = only the highest version of each document
KEEP_PDF_RENDITIONS = True             # Horizon PDF copies of an original (":PDF.pdf" in the URI)
BLOB_CONTAINER      = "s62a-documents" # blobName = path inside this container, taken from documentURI

import re
from notebookutils import mssparkutils

ACCOUNTS = {
    "dev":  "pinssts62adevukseftlkl",
    "test": "pinssts62atestuksnkavj4",
    "prod": "pinssts62aproduksrz8i4g",
}

ws = mssparkutils.env.getWorkspaceName().lower()
m  = re.search(r"(?:^|[-_])(dev|test|prod)(?:[-_]|$)", ws)
if not m:
    raise ValueError(f"Can't detect env from workspace name '{ws}'")
ENV = m.group(1)

ROOT       = f"abfss://s62a@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT or ACCOUNTS[ENV]}.dfs.core.windows.net/PIPELINE"
INPUT_DIR  = f"{ROOT}/{INPUT_SUBDIR}"
OUTPUT_DIR = f"{ROOT}/{OUTPUT_SUBDIR}"

print("Env   :", ENV)
print("Input :", INPUT_DIR)
print("Output:", OUTPUT_DIR)

docs_raw = (
    spark.read
        .format("csv")
        .option("header", "true")
        .option("multiLine", "true")
        .option("escape", "\"")
        .option("quote", "\"")
        .option("recursiveFileLookup", "true")
        .option("pathGlobFilter", "*.csv")
        .load(INPUT_DIR)
        .withColumn("_source_file", F.input_file_name())
)

print("Columns:", docs_raw.columns)
print("Row count:", docs_raw.count())
display(docs_raw.orderBy("_source_file").limit(50))

def clean_ts(col):
    return (F.when(F.col(col).isNull() | F.lower(F.trim(F.col(col))).isin("undefined", "null", ""),
                   F.lit(None).cast("timestamp"))
             .otherwise(F.to_timestamp(F.trim(F.col(col)), "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss")))

docs_clean = (
    docs_raw
    .withColumn("dateCreated", clean_ts("dateCreated"))
    .withColumn("lastModified", clean_ts("lastModified"))
    .withColumn("uploadedDate", F.col("dateCreated"))
)
docs_clean.printSchema()

# Case ref from the folder path (S62A_2024_0033) -> MPA reference (S62A/2024/0000033) -> S62aCase GUID
docs_x = (
    docs_clean
    .withColumn("pathYear", F.regexp_extract("path", r"(?i)S62A_(\d{4})_\d+", 1))
    .withColumn("pathNum",  F.regexp_extract("path", r"(?i)S62A_\d{4}_(\d+)", 1))
    .withColumn("caseReference",
        F.when(F.col("pathYear") == "", None)
         .otherwise(F.concat(F.lit("S62A/"), F.col("pathYear"), F.lit("/"),
                             F.lpad(F.col("pathNum").cast("int").cast("string"), REF_DIGITS, "0"))))
    .withColumn("s62aCaseId", make_guid(F.lit("S62aCase"), F.col("caseReference")))
    .withColumn("relPath", F.regexp_extract("path", r"(?i)S62A_\d{4}_\d+[^/]*/(.*)$", 1))
    .withColumn("relPath", F.when(F.length("relPath") == 0, None).otherwise(F.col("relPath")))
    .drop("pathYear", "pathNum")
)

print("Docs rows:", docs_x.count())
print("Missing case reference:", docs_x.filter(F.col("caseReference").isNull()).count())
print("Duplicate documentIds (check before building the Document table):",
      docs_x.groupBy("documentId").count().filter("count > 1").count())

# Every case in the extract must exist in the migrated cases (same GUID rule), otherwise the folders would be orphans
cases = (spark.read.option("header", "true").csv(f"{ROOT}/OUTPUT/SCHEMA/latest/S62aCase.csv")
         .select(F.col("id").alias("caseGuid")))
unmatched = (docs_x.select("caseReference", "s62aCaseId").distinct()
             .join(cases, F.col("s62aCaseId") == F.col("caseGuid"), "left_anti"))
print("Cases in extract:", docs_x.select("caseReference").distinct().count(),
      "| not found in S62aCase:", unmatched.count())
display(unmatched)
display(docs_x.select("documentId", "path", "caseReference", "s62aCaseId", "relPath").limit(50))

docs_with_segments = (
    docs_x
    .withColumn("pathSegments", F.when(F.col("relPath").isNotNull(), F.split("relPath", "/")))
    .withColumn("ancestorPaths",
        F.when(F.col("relPath").isNull(), F.array().cast("array<string>"))
         .otherwise(F.transform(F.sequence(F.lit(1), F.size("pathSegments")),
                                lambda i: F.array_join(F.slice(F.col("pathSegments"), F.lit(1), i), "/"))))
)
display(docs_with_segments.select("documentId", "relPath", "ancestorPaths").limit(20))

# Folder tree per case. Ids are deterministic (case ref + folder path) so reruns give the same GUIDs.
exploded_folders = (
    docs_with_segments
    .filter(F.col("s62aCaseId").isNotNull())
    .select("caseReference", "s62aCaseId", F.explode("ancestorPaths").alias("folderPath"))
    .dropDuplicates(["caseReference", "folderPath"])
)

folders_shaped = (
    exploded_folders
    .withColumn("depth", F.size(F.split("folderPath", "/")))
    .withColumn("displayName", F.element_at(F.split("folderPath", "/"), -1))
    .withColumn("parentPath",
        F.when(F.col("depth") == 1, F.lit(None).cast("string"))
         .otherwise(F.expr("array_join(slice(split(folderPath, '/'), 1, depth - 1), '/')")))
    .withColumn("id", make_guid(F.lit("Folder"), F.col("caseReference"), F.col("folderPath")))
)

sibling_window = Window.partitionBy("caseReference", "parentPath").orderBy("displayName")
folders_shaped = folders_shaped.withColumn("displayOrder", F.row_number().over(sibling_window) * 100)

folders_final = (
    folders_shaped.alias("f")
    .join(folders_shaped.alias("p"),
          (F.col("f.caseReference") == F.col("p.caseReference")) & (F.col("f.parentPath") == F.col("p.folderPath")),
          "left")
    .select(
        F.col("f.id").alias("id"),
        F.col("f.displayName").alias("displayName"),
        F.col("f.displayOrder").alias("displayOrder"),
        F.col("p.id").alias("parentFolderId"),
        F.col("f.s62aCaseId").alias("s62aCaseId"),
        F.lit(True).alias("isCustom"),
        F.lit(None).cast("timestamp").alias("deletedAt"),
        F.col("f.caseReference").alias("caseReference"),
        F.col("f.folderPath").alias("legacyFolderPath"),
        F.col("f.depth").alias("depth"),
    )
)

print("Folder rows to load:", folders_final.count())
display(folders_final.orderBy("caseReference", "legacyFolderPath"))

docs_with_folder = (
    docs_with_segments.alias("d")
    .join(folders_final.select(F.col("caseReference").alias("f_ref"), F.col("legacyFolderPath").alias("f_path"),
                               F.col("id").alias("folderId")),
          (F.col("d.caseReference") == F.col("f_ref")) & (F.col("d.relPath") == F.col("f_path")), "left")
    .drop("f_ref", "f_path")
)

print("Docs with relPath but no folderId (should be 0):",
      docs_with_folder.filter(F.col("relPath").isNotNull() & F.col("folderId").isNull()).count())
print("Docs at case root (no folder - Document.folderId is required, so these need a root folder):",
      docs_with_folder.filter(F.col("relPath").isNull()).count())
display(docs_with_folder.select("documentId", "caseReference", "relPath", "folderId").limit(50))

# Documents: one row per file. A documentId can have several versions and a PDF rendition of the original,
# each a separate blob, so the document URI is the unique key.
import pandas as pd

docs = docs_with_folder.drop("pathSegments", "ancestorPaths").toPandas()
docs = docs.astype(object).where(docs.notna() & (docs != ""), None)

exceptions = []
def log(ref, column, value, issue, severity="ACTION"):
    exceptions.append({"severity": severity, "caseReference": ref, "column": column,
                       "value": None if value is None else str(value)[:300], "issue": issue})

docs["isPdfRendition"] = docs["documentURI"].astype(str).str.contains(r":PDF\.pdf$", case=False)
docs["versionNum"] = pd.to_numeric(docs["version"], errors="coerce").fillna(1).astype(int)

for r in docs[docs.duplicated("documentURI", keep="first")].itertuples():
    log(r.caseReference, "documentURI", r.documentURI, "Exact same file listed twice, second copy dropped", "INFO")
docs = docs.drop_duplicates("documentURI", keep="first")

if not KEEP_PDF_RENDITIONS:
    log(None, "documentURI", int(docs.isPdfRendition.sum()), "PDF renditions excluded (KEEP_PDF_RENDITIONS = False)", "INFO")
    docs = docs[~docs.isPdfRendition]
if not KEEP_ALL_VERSIONS:
    latest = docs.groupby("documentId")["versionNum"].transform("max")
    log(None, "version", int((docs.versionNum < latest).sum()), "Older versions excluded (KEEP_ALL_VERSIONS = False)", "INFO")
    docs = docs[docs.versionNum == latest]

print(f"Files: {len(docs)} | PDF renditions: {int(docs.isPdfRendition.sum())} | "
      f"documents with >1 version: {int((docs.groupby('documentId').versionNum.nunique() > 1).sum())}")

# Map to the Prisma Document columns
MIME = {"pdf": "application/pdf", "doc": "application/msword",
        "docx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
        "xls": "application/vnd.ms-excel", "xlsx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet",
        "xlsm": "application/vnd.ms-excel.sheet.macroEnabled.12", "ppt": "application/vnd.ms-powerpoint",
        "pptx": "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation",
        "odt": "application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.text", "rtf": "application/rtf", "txt": "text/plain",
        "csv": "text/csv", "msg": "application/vnd.ms-outlook", "eml": "message/rfc822",
        "jpg": "image/jpeg", "jpeg": "image/jpeg", "png": "image/png", "gif": "image/gif", "tif": "image/tiff",
        "tiff": "image/tiff", "mp4": "video/mp4", "mov": "video/quicktime", "zip": "application/zip",
        "url": "text/plain", "ini": "text/plain"}

def ext_of(name):
    m = re.search(r"\.([A-Za-z0-9]+)$", str(name or ""))
    return m.group(1).lower() if m else None

def blob_name(uri):
    m = re.search(rf"/{re.escape(BLOB_CONTAINER)}/(.+)$", str(uri or ""))
    return m.group(1) if m else None

def to_size(v, ref):
    try:
        return int(float(v))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        log(ref, "size", v, "Not a number, set to 0")
        return 0

def fmt_ts(v):
    return None if v is None or pd.isna(v) else pd.Timestamp(v).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

folder_ids = set(r["id"] for r in folders_final.select("id").collect())
case_ids   = set(r["caseGuid"] for r in cases.collect())

out, rejected = [], []
for r in docs.itertuples():
    ref = r.caseReference
    ext = ext_of(r.filename) or (str(r.mime).lower() if r.mime and str(r.mime).lower() in MIME else None)
    mime = MIME.get(ext) if ext else None
    if mime is None:
        mime = "application/octet-stream"
        log(ref, "mimeType", f"{r.filename} ({r.mime})", "Unknown file type, set to application/octet-stream", "INFO")
    blob = blob_name(r.documentURI)
    rec = {"id": make_guid.func("Document", r.documentURI), "fileName": r.filename,
           "uploadedDate": fmt_ts(r.uploadedDate) or fmt_ts(r.dateCreated), "size": to_size(r.size, ref),
           "blobName": blob, "mimeType": mime, "deletedAt": None, "publishDate": None,
           "s62aCaseId": r.s62aCaseId, "folderId": r.folderId}
    problem = ("no folder (document sits at the case root)" if not rec["folderId"]
               else "folder not in Folder.csv" if rec["folderId"] not in folder_ids
               else "case not in S62aCase" if rec["s62aCaseId"] not in case_ids
               else "no file name" if not rec["fileName"]
               else "blob path not found in documentURI" if not blob
               else None)
    if problem:
        rejected.append({**rec, "caseReference": ref, "documentId": r.documentId, "path": r.path, "reason": problem})
        log(ref, "Document", r.filename, f"Rejected: {problem}")
        continue
    out.append(rec)

DOC_COLS = ["id", "fileName", "uploadedDate", "size", "blobName", "mimeType", "deletedAt", "publishDate", "s62aCaseId", "folderId"]
document = pd.DataFrame(out, columns=DOC_COLS)
assert document["id"].is_unique, "Duplicate Document ids"
exceptions_df = pd.DataFrame(exceptions, columns=["severity", "caseReference", "column", "value", "issue"])
rejected_df = pd.DataFrame(rejected)

print(f"Document rows: {len(document)} | rejected: {len(rejected_df)}")
print(exceptions_df.groupby(["severity", "issue"]).size().to_string() if len(exceptions_df) else "No exceptions")

# Write everything to OUTPUT/DOCUMENTS/latest (+ timestamped copy)
tmp = "/tmp/s62a_documents"
os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)

FOLDER_COLS = ["id", "displayName", "displayOrder", "parentFolderId", "s62aCaseId", "isCustom", "deletedAt"]
folder_schema = (folders_final.withColumn("isCustom", F.lit(1))
                 .orderBy("depth", "s62aCaseId", "legacyFolderPath")      # parents before children
                 .select(*FOLDER_COLS).toPandas())
folder_lineage = (folders_final.select("id", "s62aCaseId", "caseReference", "legacyFolderPath", "depth")
                  .orderBy("caseReference", "legacyFolderPath").toPandas())

outputs = {"Folder.csv": folder_schema, "Document.csv": document, "_folder_lineage.csv": folder_lineage,
           "_document_exceptions.csv": exceptions_df, "_document_rejected.csv": rejected_df}
for name, frame in outputs.items():
    frame.to_csv(f"{tmp}/{name}", index=False, encoding="utf-8")

for folder in (RUN_TS, "latest"):
    dest = f"{OUTPUT_DIR}/{folder}"
    if folder == "latest":
        try:
            mssparkutils.fs.rm(dest, True)
        except Exception:
            pass
    for name in outputs:
        mssparkutils.fs.cp(f"file:{tmp}/{name}", f"{dest}/{name}")
    print("Written to", dest)
print({k: len(v) for k, v in outputs.items()})
